description: Canonical Meta CAPI event taxonomy for the solar_direct funnel (solar.drillchile.cl -> Metria). Source of truth for QA acceptance tests; keep this file in sync with Backend/src/modules/meta-events/metaEvents.service.ts and metaEvents.capi.ts — do not let them drift again.

transport_history.name: google_sheets_bridge
transport_history.note: 5-minute cron import from a Google Sheet populated by Apps Script. Replaced by direct_metria_api (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-01-solar-metria-direct-integration-design.md) to cut CAPI event latency and remove the Sheets single point of failure. sheets.service.ts / sheets.cron.ts remain in the codebase for other, non-solar integrations only.

transport_history.name: direct_metria_api
transport_history.note: solar's server actions (src/app/actions.ts, repo C:\repo\drillchile\solar) POST directly to Backend's POST /api/public/solar/lead (Backend/src/modules/leads/solarLead.routes.ts), authenticated via X-Solar-Api-Key. leadIngestion.service.ts persists the Contact/Deal and fires CAPI inline on the `complete` action — no cron, no polling.

event_id_pattern.subjectId_rule: sessionId when known (Contact, Lead, FinanceApplicationSubmitted) so a future browser-side Pixel call using the same sessionId can dedupe against CAPI under the same event_id; falls back to Contact.id otherwise (QualifiedLead, TechnicalReviewCompleted).
event_id_pattern.suffix_rule: appointmentId for Schedule, dealId for Purchase — lets multiple of those events exist per Contact without colliding on the same event_id.

events.name: Contact
events.owner: capi: Backend emitMetaContactEvent (leadIngestion.service.ts finalizeLead); pixel: solar page.tsx fbq('track','Contact') gated on leadCompleted
events.trigger: Wizard's 'complete' action (Contacto step confirmed) — the funnel's real conversion moment, not any earlier 'save' step.

events.name: Lead
events.trigger: Same 'complete' action as Contact, fired immediately after it.
events.decision: CAPI-only, not Pixel+CAPI. An earlier contract draft required Pixel+CAPI; the implementation deliberately never added a Pixel-side Lead call because solar making its own Graph API calls produced a second, uncoordinated event_id for the same lead (dc:v1:<sessionId>:... from solar vs dc:v2:<Contact.id>:... from Metria) that Meta could never deduplicate (see actions.ts completeLead() doc comment). One emitter (Metria) is the durable rule going forward.

events.name: FinanceApplicationSubmitted
events.trigger: 'complete' action when the payload includes any financing-step field (edad, estadoCivil, valorCasa, deudaCasa, ingresoMensual, profesion, deudaContribuciones, embargoVigente) — i.e. the lead filled the financing step, not merely a base quote.
events.canonical_name_decision: FinanceApplicationSubmitted is the one canonical name. Historical docs used SubmitApplication — that name is retired, not an alias; do not resurrect it (see commit 328ea3a1, 'chore(meta-events): remove dead SubmitApplication event name').
events.note: No financial PII (RUT, income, debts, net worth, profession, marital status, garnishment) is ever sent to Meta — only the fact that the step was submitted.

events.name: QualifiedLead
events.trigger: Explicit human confirmation in the CRM (sales agent marks a lead as qualified) — never fired automatically from finalizeLead regardless of the automated qualifier's result.

events.name: Schedule
events.trigger: A visit/appointment is booked for the Contact.

events.name: TechnicalReviewCompleted
events.trigger: Technical site visit / review marked complete.

events.name: Purchase
events.owner: Backend emitMetaPurchaseEvent (pipeline.service.ts moveDeal/closeDeal via hasConfirmedPurchase gate)
events.trigger: Deal reaches the WON pipeline stage AND contractId AND contractSignedAt AND initialPaymentConfirmedAt AND confirmedContractValue AND currency === 'CLP' are all set. Reaching WON alone is not sufficient evidence of a sale.

pixel_events.PageView: fires on every page load via the base snippet (src/app/MetaPixelScript.tsx in the solar repo).
pixel_events.ViewContent: fires once the wizard reaches the results screen, gated on leadCompleted + consent + fbq being defined.
pixel_events.Contact: see events[].Contact above — pixel side is the browser-visible half of the same funnel moment CAPI reports server-side.

consent_gate.rule: No event of any kind reaches Meta (Pixel or CAPI) unless consent is recorded. Server-side: finalizeLead() rejects with 422 if consentAccepted !== true or consentVersion is missing/empty, before any Contact is resolved or CAPI call is attempted (Backend/src/modules/leads/leadIngestion.service.ts:166-171, regression-tested in leadIngestion.service.test.ts). consentStatus is never client-supplied — hardcoded to 'granted' server-side only after those checks pass.
consent_gate.verified: QA_E2E_POST_FIXES_04AGO2026.md P0-6 asked this to be demonstrated — it already was, by the two existing 422-rejection tests in leadIngestion.service.test.ts ('rechaza con 422 si consentAccepted no es true' / '... si consentVersion falta o está vacío'), both of which assert prisma.contact.findUnique was never called.

outbox_and_retry.table: ConversionEvent (Backend/prisma/schema.prisma) — one row per attempted event, audit trail + idempotency.
outbox_and_retry.dedup: Unique on (pixelId, eventName, eventId) at the DB level (metaEvents.capi.ts) — a retried finalizeLead for the same session is safe, P2002 violations are swallowed as an expected duplicate.
outbox_and_retry.retry: metaEvents.cron.ts retryPendingConversionEvents(), every 5 minutes, sweeps rows in status pending/retry with attemptCount < MAX_ATTEMPTS (5) whose nextRetryAt has elapsed. Regression-tested in metaEvents.cron.test.ts.
outbox_and_retry.dashboard: Settings -> Meta Events shows event_name, event_id, status, HTTP status, events_received, fbtrace_id, last_error, attempts, created_at, sent_at per event (MetaEventsClient.tsx).
